regions.today: A cool evening with scattered showers gradually easing and dying out in a brisk northerly wind.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry for most with long clear spells and just isolated showers. Chilly with lowest temperatures of 2 to 4 degrees in decreasing northerly winds. Some frost possible in sheltered spots.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will bring a mix of sunny spells and well scattered light showers. Highest temperatures of 12 to 14 degrees in light to moderate northwest winds.
